To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the body perception treatment is an efficacious treatment for body image disturbance in ED inpatients.
the BPT is an effective treatment for BID, and that it can be added to the usual treatment for ED patients.
The addition of BPT to the usual ED protocol showed significantly better clinical outcomes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of a treatment for body image disturbance in a group of inpatients with an eating disorder diagnosis.
the development of an innovative treatment for the body image disturbance, a symptom that has not yet been sufficiently addressed in eating disorder treatments.
the efficacy of a treatment for body image disturbance (the body perception treatment) in patients with an eating disorder (AN, BN and BED) admitted to a hospital specialized in ED.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the results of this study show that BPT, in addition to the usual treatment for ED patients, can be considered an effective and safe intervention.
the body perception treatment added to the usual treatment in a hospital ward for eating disorders has an additional effect on the clinical results.
BPT has a positive effect on the body uneaseness and on the overall clinical outcome.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the body image disturbance (affective, cognitive, and especially perceptual) is a common and important symptom in eating disorders; the current treatments of the BID have focused mainly on the affective/cognitive components of this symptom; the body perception treatment is a new treatment focused on the perceptural component of the BIDs; the body perception treatement added to the usual treatment of eating disorders (TAU) showed an additional effect on body uneasiness and on general psychopathological status.

1) the body image disturbance is a common symptom among eating disorders; 2) the body image is not only an affective and cognitive component but also a perceptual one; 3) BPT is an effective treatment in reducing the body uneasyness; 4) BPT is a useful tool to be integrated into the ED protocol.
the body image disturbance is a complex and multidimensional phenomenon that requires a multidisciplinary approach to treatment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the BPT, a new treatment focused on the perceptive component of the BIDs, can be an effective tool to improve the clinical results of patients affected by eating disorders.
the body perception treatment can be a useful additional tool to the current treatment of eating disorders.
the BPT can be a useful tool to be added to a usual ED treatment protocol.
